mostWorthwhile.text: Linking the wings to the follower was most worthwhile: it showed how a rising rod can turn two hinged wings.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to attach the rods before mounting the dragon was a small false start, though the automatic mounting made the required order clear.

surprise.text: The cam exchange needed a keeper pin and shaft removal; it was more involved than simply swapping a disc.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely arbitrary, although the required mounting order was not obvious before I tried the rods.

continue.text: Yes. Comparing the greetings made the mechanism understandable, and Jo’s unfinished fair drawing made me curious about what the toys might become part of.
